enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Command: Passive: +2 competence bonus on Charisma based skill checks. Command armor and command shields make their owners very noticeable, imposing a -6 penalty on Hide checks.

Adamantine: Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Heavy armor made from adamantine grants its wearer damage reduction of 3/-.
